{{Quote|Watch those wrist rockets!|Various clone troopers|<ref name="SWBFII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>}}
'''Wrist rocket launchers''' were miniaturized [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]] capable of being worn on the wrist. They fired various types of [[Wrist rocket/Legends|wrist rockets]], including [[Dart/Legends|darts]] and small [[Missile/Legends|missiles]]. They were a favorite of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] due to their discreet nature, versatility, and power. Bounty hunter [[Mira]] used a wrist rocket launcher as her trademark weapon. Another model of wrist rocket launcher was the [[Kelvarek Consolidated Arms/Legends|Kelvarex Consolidated Arms]] [[MM9 mini concussion rocket launcher/Legends|MM9 rocket system]], which was used by bounty hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].
